title: Affine-line projection stalk bound from punctured smooth strict localizations
statement: Fix a universe u, an algebraically closed field K:Type u, n in N, and d=n+2. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], residue transcendence degree as in [def-kun-transcendence-degree], and strict localizations and structural maps as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Assume the following six inputs. (P1) For every u-scheme S and locally torsion abelian etale sheaf F on P^1_S, R^q pi_*F=0 for q>2. (Boundary) For any open immersion j:U->Y with closed complement i:Z->Y and retraction g:Y->Z of i, every abelian etale sheaf M on U satisfies R^p g_*R^q j_*M=0 for p,q positive. (Stalk) For every qcqs f:X->S, algebraically closed geometric point s:Spec Omega->S, torsion abelian sheaf F and q in N, H^q(X times_S S_(s),p^*F)=0 implies the geometric stalk (R^q f_*F)_s=0. (Leray) For all scheme maps j:X->Y, g:Y->S, s:T->S, all abelian etale sheaves M on X, and r in N, if s^*R^p g_*R^q j_*M=0 for every p+q=r then s^*R^r(gj)_*M=0. (AffineLine) For every u-small commutative ring K and m in N, the explicit last-coordinate projection A^(m+1)_K->A^m_K is isomorphic over its base to the structural morphism of the relative affine line A^1_(A^m_K). (Cartier) For every smooth integral finite-type Y/K of dimension d, algebraically closed geometric point s above y with trdeg_K kappa(y)=a<d, and every nonzero h in the maximal ideal of R=O^sh_(Y,s), cd_tor(Spec R[1/h])<=d-a. The scalar structures K->kappa(y)->Omega and K->R in this input are required to induce the canonical structural morphisms of the point and strict localization, exactly as in the Lean signature. Then let f:A^d_K->A^(d-1)_K be the last-coordinate projection, given on coordinate rings by MvPolynomial.rename Fin.castSucc. For every sheaf M of abelian groups on A^d_K killed by a positive integer N, every q>=2, every separably closed field Omega:Type u and s:Spec Omega->A^(d-1)_K with image y, the cardinal inequality d<q+trdeg_K kappa(y) implies s^*(R^q f_*M)=0. The projective-line, inverse-image and geometric-stalk conventions are [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

proof.text: Use the supplied relative-affine-line identification to embed the explicitly presented polynomial source as the standard affine chart of Y=P^1_B, where B=A^(d-1)_K. The infinity section is the closed complement. Its second chart supplies the nonzero boundary coordinate. The two polynomial charts show that Y is smooth, integral and of dimension d over K.

At a boundary point y, let a=trdeg_K kappa(y). The infinity section identifies its residue field with that of its image in B, so a<=d-1. In the infinity chart the divisor is cut out by the affine coordinate h. Its image in the strict henselization is in the maximal ideal and is nonzero: smoothness gives the regular strict-local domain and the coordinate remains a nonzerodivisor under the flat strict-local map. The supplied punctured strict-local bound hCartier gives cd_tor(Spec R[1/h])<=d-a. The pullback of j to this strict localization is Spec R[1/h]. The supplied comparison hStalk therefore gives zero stalks of R^r j_*M for r>d-a. Away from the boundary these positive direct images vanish, since open restriction is exact, preserves injectives, and identifies j with the identity.

For r>0, the closed-support equivalence gives R^r j_*M=i_*N_r: restrict to the affine chart to get zero, then use the closed immersion unit and geometric-stalk conservativity. The supplied hBoundary gives R^p g_*R^r j_*M=0 for p>0,r>0. Additivity preserves the annihilator N, including on j_*M; since N is positive, j_*M is locally torsion. The supplied hP1 gives R^p g_*j_*M=0 for p>2.

For r>2 apply the supplied exact-inverse-image Leray diagonal-vanishing statement. Diagonal terms with p,q positive vanish by the supplied mixed-degree boundary acyclicity; q=0 vanishes by the supplied projective-line bound; p=0 vanishes at the chosen point by the boundary strict-local calculation and finite-stalk formula. Thus the projected higher direct image vanishes at this point.

In degree r=2, the inequality forces the base point to have maximal residue transcendence degree d-1, hence to be the generic point: a nonzero prime of the polynomial ring imposes a nonzero relation among the d-1 coordinate residues. The smooth strict-local field model at the generic point gives a zero-dimensional regular local domain, which is its separably closed residue field. The pullback of f to this strict localization is the affine line over that field. Its torsion cohomological dimension is at most one by the affine curve theorem, so H^2 vanishes. Apply hStalk to get the generic stalk vanishing. Finally, for a separably closed geometric field Omega, extend to its algebraic closure. This purely inseparable extension induces an equivalence of etale topoi; the geometric-stalk/inverse-image comparison transports the vanishing back to s^*R^r f_*M.

lean.statement:
theorem affineLineProjection_stalk_bound
    (hP1 : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
      (F : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine S).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}), F.IsTorsion → ∀ q : ℕ, 2 < q →
      IsZero (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).rightDerived q).obj F))
    (hBoundary : ∀ {U Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
      (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] (g : Y ⟶ Z),
      Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ → i ≫ g = 𝟙 Z →
      ∀ (M : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (p q : ℕ),
      0 < p → 0 < q →
      IsZero (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).rightDerived p).obj
        (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} j).rightDerived q).obj M)))
    (hStalk : ∀ {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
      {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
      (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}), F.IsTorsion → ∀ q : ℕ,
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).obj F) q) →
      IsZero ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj F)))
    (hLeray : ∀ {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) (s : T ⟶ S)
      (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (r : ℕ),
      (∀ p q : ℕ, p + q = r →
        IsZero ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} s).obj
          (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).rightDerived p).obj
            (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} j).rightDerived q).obj M)))) →
      IsZero ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} s).obj
        (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (j ≫ g)).rightDerived r).obj M)))
    (hAffineLine : ∀ (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (m : ℕ),
      let B := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin m) K))
      let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.rename
        (Fin.castSucc : Fin m → Fin (m + 1))).toRingHom)
      ∃ e : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) K)) ≅ AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} B,
        e.hom ≫ AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} B ↘ B = f)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ)
    (hCartier : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y]
        (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
        (a : ℕ), a < n + 2 → topologicalKrullDim Y = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) →
        ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
          (y : Y), s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = y →
        ∀ [Algebra K (Y.residueField y)],
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (Y.residueField y))) =
            Y.fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f →
        ∀ [Algebra (Y.residueField y) Ω],
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) Ω)) ≫
            Y.fromSpecResidueField y = s →
          Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y) = (a : Cardinal.{u}) →
        ∀ [Algebra K (strictHenselizationRing s)],
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (strictHenselizationRing s))) =
            strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ≫ f →
        ∀ (h : strictHenselizationRing s), h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ → h ≠ 0 →
          (Spec (.of (Localization.Away h))).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (n + 2 - a))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K))).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : N • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
      let f : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K)) ⟶
          Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)) :=
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.rename
          (Fin.castSucc : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 2))).toRingHom)
      let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)))
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))),
        ((n + 2 : ℕ) : Cardinal.{u}) < (q : Cardinal.{u}) +
            residueFieldTrdeg b (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) →
          IsZero ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} s).obj
            (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj M))
